# Human2Humanoid Should Observation Noise Be Added in Policy Distillation Phase?

> **Current answer:** The project contributor confirmed only one project fact: the distillation phase did not add noise, and stated that the deployment was effective. The post did not explain why this is feasible, nor compare it with a noise-added configuration, so it can only be reused as a record for Human2Humanoid implementation and cannot be concluded that other robots do not need noise randomness.
